name: IRS Form W-9 TIN & tax worksheet
description: When onboarding as an independent contractor, vendor, or freelancer in the United States, clients routinely request IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification). Form W-9 requires sensitive financial and personal data, including your full legal name, business entity classification (sole proprietor, LLC, C Corp, S Corp), address, and your Social Security Number (SSN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN). Using online PDF form fillers exposes your SSN—the primary credential for US identity theft—to commercial cloud databases. PrivacyFold's IRS Form W-9 Tax Worksheet allows contractors to format, validate, and calculate their W-9 data entirely inside local browser memory. No tax data is ever uploaded, ensuring complete compliance with IRS privacy guidelines and zero exposure of your SSN.

faqs.question: Is my Social Security Number (SSN) safe when using this tool?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely safe. PrivacyFold operates 100% on your device using client-side JavaScript. Your SSN is stored exclusively in your browser's local volatile memory and is never transmitted over the internet or saved to any database.

faqs.question: Does this tool support the latest IRS Form W-9 revision?
faqs.answer: Yes. The worksheet maps directly to IRS Form W-9 (Rev. March 2024 / November 2024 specifications), including Line 1 (Name), Line 2 (Business Name), Line 3a/b (Tax Classification and Partnership check boxes), and Part I (TIN).

faqs.question: Can I use an EIN instead of an SSN?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool validates both 9-digit Social Security Numbers (format: XXX-XX-XXXX) and 9-digit Employer Identification Numbers (format: XX-XXXXXXX).

faqs.question: Does this tool submit my Form W-9 to the IRS?
faqs.answer: No. The IRS does not accept direct digital W-9 submissions from individuals. Form W-9 is given directly to the requester (your client or employer) who is required to retain it for tax records.

faqs.question: Can I use this tool while offline without Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Yes. Once cached by your browser, PrivacyFold runs completely offline. You can disconnect your network connection and fill out your tax worksheet with total confidence.

faqs.question: What are the penalties for providing false W-9 information?
faqs.answer: Under federal law, willful failure to provide a correct TIN or making false certifications can subject a taxpayer to IRS civil penalties of $50 per failure, 24% backup withholding, or criminal penalties under 26 U.S. Code § 7206.

steps: Enter your legal name as shown on your federal income tax return.
Select your federal tax classification (Sole proprietor, Single-member LLC, Partnership, C Corporation, S Corporation).
Input your Taxpayer Identification Number (SSN or EIN) with instant local format validation.
Verify backup withholding exemption codes if applicable.
Download your completed, print-ready W-9 worksheet or copy structured fields to your official IRS PDF.
